ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the money this trip would produce is agreed and modest, but it cannot be paid out on this record, so the case goes to a human reviewer and the SGD 9.50 in dispute is held rather than collected or refunded. WHAT IS AGREED. The fare was METERED (EV-FARE-02850): charged_total SGD 26.73, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00. The booked optimal route was 14.0 km / 19.0 min (EV-TRIP-02850). On those figures the recomputed fare is (3.80 + 0.75 x 14.0 + 0.28 x 19.0) x 1.0 surge (read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier) + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP = SGD 20.42, a difference of SGD 6.31, rounding up to SGD 6.35. Both sides computed that, and it is arithmetically correct. WHY NO MONETARY RULING ISSUES. The GPS trace EV-GPS-02850 is impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07: it carries a 100.0-second gap between consecutive fixes (22:07:31 to 22:09:11), above the 90-second limb (a) threshold, so it is impaired for policy purposes and not merely schema-flagged. The admissibility pre-pass also tagged it IMPAIRED (issue GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW) at weight_multiplier 0.6, which both advocates disclosed. Under POL-RD-07(ii) a deviation may NOT be established on an impaired trace alone; it must be carried by an independent source. I checked each source the clause names and none is present: the chat log EV-CHAT-02850 is empty (0 messages) so there is no driver admission; the fare_breakdown EV-FARE-02850 has no ERP gantries charged and no line placing the vehicle on a corridor the optimal route avoids; the fare_breakdown's billed distance (18.2 km) is a copy of the trace figure and is expressly not independent corroboration; and trip_record.actual_distance_km of 18.2 km (EV-TRIP-02850) is, under POL-RD-01, 'a rounded convenience copy of the same measurement' - it equals the trace figure exactly and is one carrier with the trace, not a second. The claim that this figure is an independently derived corroboration is rejected. No corroboration therefore exists, and POL-RD-07(iii) and POL-RD-10(3) require ESCALATE rather than a finding in either direction. POL-RD-13 does not alter this: it states in terms that where the trace is impaired under POL-RD-07(a)-(c) and no POL-RD-07(ii) corroboration exists, POL-RD-10(3) still governs. Independently, the deciding distance fact is carried only by the 0.6-weight trace, so under POL-GEN-02(2) confidence cannot exceed 0.6, below the 0.70 floor that POL-RD-10(1) enforces. The driver's counterparty statement ('Navigation rerouted me') is evidence and is considered, but it carries no weight_multiplier, cannot lift that cap, and is in any event an uncorroborated assertion about cause rather than a record of the measured route, so it neither corroborates the deviation nor dissolves the escalation. CLAIMS ANSWERED. The driver's asserted external traffic cause is weightless: no traffic_advisory covers this window (EV-ADVIS-02850-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0) and POL-RD-03 is unavailable. POL-RD-04 does not apply (empty chat log, no rider instruction, no waypoint_hint). POL-RD-05 and POL-RD-12 do not apply (no amendment timestamps, amended_optimal_distance_km null; vehicle type RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL). POL-RD-09 produces nothing to correct on top (tolls_erp 0.00, airport_surcharge 0.00, no gantries). POL-RD-06 is not engaged: the deviation is not material (30.0% below 50%, 4.2 km below 8.0 km) and no pattern exists (deviation_flags_90d 0 over 417 completed_trips_90d), so there is no FULL_REFUND uplift and no conduct referral. POL-RD-08's rider-side corroboration uplift is not triggered (deviation_claims_60d 0). No profile field decides anything: rating, prior_disputes_filed, prior_disputes_upheld and prior_deviation_flags are context only under POL-GEN-01 and are not relied on. Claims the referee discarded for citing the impaired artifacts without naming their issue codes are recorded in discarded_claims and are not relied on. WHAT WOULD RESOLVE THIS: a complete or repaired trace, or one of the independent sources POL-RD-07(ii) names - a chat-log admission, charged ERP gantries placing the vehicle on a corridor the optimal route does not use, a counterparty statement admitting the measured route, or a platform-derived distance figure that is not a copy of this trace. No referral issues: no clause in this case produces one.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
